calculation.description: The prior completed session's 20-session net log return divided by the 20-session absolute-return path length, cross-sectionally ranked and centered. Positive values indicate efficient upward trends; negative values indicate efficient downward trends. The one-session lag prevents use of the current completed-day close in a decision.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across the full synthetic cross-asset history with 15 tradable instruments; small cross-sectional uncertainty is mitigated by 4,229 daily observations. The 10-day IC and ICIR exceed the benchmark admission gates of 0.0070 and 0.0840 in absolute value.
